description: The PWR Series complete bikes are Stay Strong's first range of race ready bikes. Ready to Race straight out of the box, the PWR Series has everything a rider needs to become a fully fledged BMX racer. Stay Strong understand riders/racers needs and every part, detail and logo placement has been thoroughly thought out. With a race winning geometry, disc specific frame, Stay Strong branded bars, cranks, rims, seat and forks and an integrated headset, quick release seat clamp, cable actuated disc brakes, ODI x Stay Strong Reactiv grips and Tioga Powerblock tyres... They have you covered. ###section### Product Specs FRAME MATERIAL: 6061 Alloy WHEEL SIZE: 20" TOP TUBE LENGTH: 20.75" CHAIN STAY LENGTH: 14.1" HEAD TUBE ANGLE: 74° SEAT TUBE ANGLE: 72° FORKS: Full 4130 Chromoly BARS: Chromoly 8" STEM: Forged Alloy Top Load, 50mm HEADSET: Sealed Intergrated BRAKE MOUNTS: Frame Mounted Disc Brake BRAKES: Mechanical Disc brake with Alloy Lever FRONT HUB: 32h Alloy Hub wih fully sealed bearing FRONT RIM: 32h Alloy Double Wall REAR HUB: 32h Alloy Cassette Hub with Disc - 16T Cog REAR RIM: 32h Alloy Double Wall TYRES: Front: Tioga Powerblock 20 x 1.75", Rear: Tioga Powerblock 20 x 1.6" SPROCKET: Steel 44t CRANKS: Alloy 2pc 175mm BB: ISIS Drive PEDALS: Slim Nylon SEAT: Stay Strong Slim Combo Seat/Post GEARING: 44/16 WEIGHT: 23.3lbs / 10.6Kgs ###section### Product Highlights Pro sized BMX race bike for riders who need a full size BMX. Typically suited to riders 5ft 3" to 5ft 8" (160cm - 175cm) A BMX race specific bike perfect for racers who want to take it to the next level Full size 1.75" wide wheels Responsive mechanical disc brake. Lightweight 6061 alloy frame ###shogun-image-section###
